eventDetail.eventTitle: 2027 International Conference on Intelligent Power, Energy and Sustainable Systems (IIPESS)
eventDetail.about: Components, Circuits, Devices and Systems; Engineering Profession; Power, Energy and Industry Applications; Robotics and Control Systems; Signal Processing and Analysis
eventDetail.sponsors: Dr B R Ambedkar National Inst of Tech Jalandhar; IEEE Industrial Electronics Society

eventDetail.scope: The conference aims to provide a vibrant platform for academicians, researchers, industry professionals, and students to exchange ideas and showcase cutting-edge advancements in the domains of power systems, power electronics and drives, signal processing, and AI/ML. IIPESS-2027 is designed to foster collaboration, innovation, and knowledge exchange, addressing contemporary challenges in energy systems. It will serve as a catalyst for discussing developments in next-generation intelligent and sustainable energy solutions, supporting the global vision of a reliable, secure, and low-carbon energy future.
